cohort: Neonates admitted to the neonatal unit of the University of Teaching Hospital, Uyo, with seizures, suspected seizures, or conditions associated with seizures.
finding: The prevalence of neonatal seizures in Uyo was 2.93%, with birth asphyxia and infective causes being the most important etiological factors, and more complications observed in babies with seizure onset within the first three days of life.
birth_weight: Measured, with the majority of newborns being term babies.
gest_age: Measured, with the majority of newborns being term babies.
